criteria.description: Exactly one h1, one description, two CTA anchors, one native background video, one scrim and one non-CTA motion control; no nav, logo, form or image
Hero and cover video fill the viewport without overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280
Owned deterministic WebM autoplays muted and looped, custom pause/play works, and reduced motion starts paused
Both CTA anchors resolve to real owned documents
AA overlay contrast, visible focus, 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
JavaScript-disabled view keeps copy, destinations, video and native pause controls usable
Codex reviews fresh desktop, tablet, mobile, dark, paused, reduced-motion and JavaScript-disabled captures
